jobs.what: CPU: hash-pinned wheel and source fetch under D1 (pip download --require-hashes)
CPU: offline overlay build FROM the vLLM 0.31.0 overlay (verl, ray, FLA 0.5.2, Math-Verify; flash-attn from source or the torch varlen patch)
CPU: selftests (imports; Hydra resolves rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.mamba_ssm_cache_dtype into the vllm serve argv; gradient-dump hook unit test)
trainer anchor: verl FSDP2 compute_log_prob on G2b's 48 seed-42 4B rollouts (942,608 tokens) against G2b's host-kept r1/r2 and decode log-probs
smoke: fp32 3 GRPO steps (checkpoint after step 2, step-3 batch saved), bf16 and fp16 2 steps each; 8 prompts x 4 at a 4,096 cap; engine-logged state dtype
resume: fresh job loads the step-2 checkpoint, replays the saved step-3 batch, compares parameters with P2a's step 3; SIGUSR1 save-on-signal test
calibration fp32: lr 0, R = 4 replicate batches (32 prompts x 8, 16,384 cap, sampling seeds 42-45), per-token in-loop log-probs, full-gradient dumps
calibration bf16: as P3a, plus a second backward on every batch with token-TIS weights (C = 2), both gradients dumped
CPU: in-loop mismatch tables, gradient Gram matrix, readouts

p3_arithmetic.startup_s: Ray, model load, vLLM start with CUDA graphs: about 300
p3_arithmetic.rule: a P3 job cut before its fourth batch reports R = 3 and its gradient readout is estimation only

gradient_dump_storage_gb.per_dump_fp32: about 4.3e9 language-model parameters x 4 bytes = about 17 GB
gradient_dump_storage_gb.deleted_after: P4 writes the Gram matrix; the dumps are deleted after the readouts are committed

stage0.what: learnable pool: 1,536 deduplicated DAPO-Math-17k prompts x 8 at 16,384 with fp32 state (about 135M tokens) plus base-checkpoint evaluation
stage0.arithmetic: 12,288 rollouts x about 11K tokens / (4 GPUs x about 6K tok/s) = about 6.3 GPU-h, plus 1.0 evaluation

full.note: The full design is registered after the pilot, with its per-step time replaced by P3's measurement; if the measured step exceeds 1.5 x 350 s, the design is re-sized (fewer steps or an 8,192 cap) before registration. Admission is Kevin's (D24, D92).
